input: {"question":"As a computational linguist, I model 200 word forms and 1000 undirected corpus-association links as an undirected, unweighted, simple, homogeneous lexical network. The connectivity structure is undirected, unweighted, simple, and homogeneous, comprising 100 meter devices and 400 direct communication links. input: {"question":"As a computational linguist, I model 200 word forms and 1000 undirected corpus-association links as an undirected, unweighted, simple, homogeneous lexical network.
